# BiliPai Repository LLM Entry

Canonical entry point for AI and LLM tooling. This is an index, not a copy of fast-changing build, release, or feature facts.

## Start Here

| Need | Authoritative source |
| --- | --- |
| Current build, variants, and dependencies | [`app/build.gradle.kts`](app/build.gradle.kts), [`gradle/libs.versions.toml`](gradle/libs.versions.toml), and [`settings.gradle.kts`](settings.gradle.kts) |
| Published versions and user-visible changes | [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md) |
| Product overview | [`README.md`](README.md) / [`README_EN.md`](README_EN.md) |
| Current priorities | [`docs/wiki/ROADMAP.md`](docs/wiki/ROADMAP.md) |
| Architecture and module boundaries | [`docs/wiki/ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/wiki/ARCHITECTURE.md) / [`STRUCTURE_GUIDELINES.adoc`](STRUCTURE_GUIDELINES.adoc) |
| UI contracts and page catalog | [`docs/wiki/ui-design/README.md`](docs/wiki/ui-design/README.md) |
| QA and release process | [`docs/wiki/QA.md`](docs/wiki/QA.md) / [`docs/wiki/RELEASE_WORKFLOW.md`](docs/wiki/RELEASE_WORKFLOW.md) |
| JSON or external plugins | [`docs/PLUGIN_DEVELOPMENT.md`](docs/PLUGIN_DEVELOPMENT.md) |
| Native plugins | [`docs/NATIVE_PLUGIN_DEVELOPMENT.md`](docs/NATIVE_PLUGIN_DEVELOPMENT.md) |
| Repository path map | [`docs/wiki/AI.md`](docs/wiki/AI.md) |

## Source Priority

When sources disagree, use this order:

1. Source code and build configuration.
2. `CHANGELOG.md` for released behavior.
3. `ROADMAP.md` for priorities only.
4. Current architecture, design, QA, and plugin documents.
5. README files.

`AI.txt` and `llm.txt` are compatibility aliases only. Historical audits and superseded plans are evidence, not implementation authority.
